name: flyrank-context
title_zh: 面试前先读的公司背景卡，专治「这题在考啥」
tagline_zh: 当任务提到 FlyRank 的搜索、旗标或「打败规则」，先加载这份背景，避免答偏。内含手工旗标的故事。
tagline_en: When a task mentions FlyRank's search, flags, or 'beat the rule', load this first to avoid answering off-target.
desc_en: FlyRank-specific background — what the company does, the search problem, and the hand-written flags story that the ML internship work builds on. Load for context when an assignment references FlyRank's product, flags, or the "beat the rule" framing. (Project-specific: delete this folder when reusing the skill library elsewhere.)
why_zh: 它把散落的公司背景、搜索问题和旗标叙事收拢成一份，让 ML 实习任务不再是孤立的算法题。
why_en: It consolidates scattered company background, the search problem, and the flags narrative, so ML tasks become anchored in.
limit_zh: 只适用于 FlyRank 项目；若复用技能库到其他公司，需删除此文件夹。不含具体代码或数据，仅提供背景。
limit_en: Only for FlyRank projects; delete this folder when reusing the skill library elsewhere. No code or data—just context, not a substitute for task specs.
title_en: Company context card to read before an interview
